load_box_from_mat: load bounding box data from a MATLAB .mat file for a given image directory
load_mats_multiple_datasets: load bounding box data from multiple MATLAB .mat files across several datasets
return_box_for_image: return a formatted bounding box string for an image using GTB, DET, or GTL mode
load_all_300w: load all 300W dataset bounding boxes from MATLAB files into a dictionary keyed by image path
generate_300w_list: generate train, common, challenge, and full test list files for the 300W dataset
